name: Historian Dr Alcuin

intro.text: I'm walking the walls. Two miles, with commentary. Care to join? I've been doing it since 1998. The commentary has grown.

win: A revised footnote. 'The visitor won.' I'll have to change the guidebook.
after: Alcuin of York was Charlemagne's chief scholar. The man taught the Emperor his letters. That's the sort of pupil you want.
